name: Alert Latch
description: Hook the cranequin claws over the string and seat its foot against the stock.

name: Latchlinen
description: Turn the geared handle in even half turns while qi steadies the standing leg.

name: Sound Tripbar
description: Unhook the claws in one flick the moment the string seats on the nut.

name: Stockcordial
description: Judge the steeper fall of a heavy prod bolt and lift the aim to match.

name: Trigger Hammerfall
description: Loose a bolt from a fully geared prod so the head punches through hide and thin plate.

name: Cooling Bowprod
description: Span the cranequin while standing guard so the bow is ready again without leaving the line.

name: Latchcordial
description: Count the beat of the rank so each shooter knows when to step up.

name: Fleet Stirrup
description: Kneel in the front rank so the shooters behind can loose over the head.

name: Alert Windlass
description: Raise the bow above a kneeling comrade and aim along the rail from behind.

name: Soothing Boltrail
description: Span the bow in the space behind the rank while others hold the front.

name: Veering Setback
description: Step back through the gap in the rank to the spanning place without breaking the line.

name: Latchtonic
description: Listen for the caller's word and hold the loose until it comes.

name: Releaseclack Flog
description: Loose in turns along the rank so a steady stream of bolts keeps the enemy low.

name: Guarding Stock
description: Lift a hide-faced board with a thread of qi to cover the front rank from return fire.

name: Brawnsear
description: Pull the bridle cord snug against the prod so the limbs keep their shape under draw.

name: Sure Sear
description: Rub wax along the string with a folded cloth to stop fraying and keep the draw smooth.

name: Gap Trigger
description: Run a thumbnail along the serving thread to find any slack where the string meets the nut.

name: Gap Sear
description: Span the bow half way and eye the limbs to see that both bend the same.

name: Searlinen
description: Leave the prod unspanned in shade after hard use so the limbs rest and keep their strength.

name: Dawn Cranequin
description: Push qi through the back and arms to span a prod that is stiffer than the arm alone could draw.

name: Honed Cranking
description: Loose from a freshly tuned bridled prod so the bolt drives hard into a guarded target.

name: Braced Latch
description: Plant the standing board in front of the shooter with the foot braced against its base.

name: Dawnsear
description: Crouch behind the board and span the bow where no enemy can see the shooter.

name: Emberlatch
description: Rise just above the board edge and loose one bolt and drop back down.

name: Recalllatch
description: Use the board edge as a fixed mark to judge the distance to the foe.

name: Spanzip
description: Slide sideways along the base of the board to a new firing gap.

name: Poiselatch
description: Stack bolts in the rack at the board foot so each one is within easy reach.

name: Keen Bowprod
description: Rest the bow on the board edge and loose a bolt that drives through the foe's guard.

name: Draught Twang
description: Walk the board forward in short steps with a boost of qi to the legs while keeping cover.

name: Brasssear
description: Wedge the board against the ground and the shoulder with qi to hold it through a rain of bolts.

name: Recall Stock
description: Pace out the distance to a known stone and fix that distance in memory.

name: Latchbandage
description: Glance at the marker posts along the field to read how far a target stands.

name: Knitting Windlass
description: Hold a clear steady pitch when calling a range so the line hears it over noise.

name: Genial Boltrail
description: Set the rear notch of the rail to the called range before aiming.

name: Ember Quarrel
description: Loose a bolt at a called range with the notch set and no further correction.

name: Gap Tripbar
description: Repeat the called range aloud to the next shooter so the whole line holds one distance.

name: Humsear
description: Count stacked cairns along the ground to measure the distance to an advancing foe.

name: Draught Span
description: Tilt the bow high with qi in the arms and loose a bolt in a long arc to a far mark.

name: Quarrel Swat
description: Loose bolt after bolt at one called range so a falling line of quarrels pins an advancing group.

name: Seartonic
description: Reset the notch and the stance at the caller's word to follow a foe that has closed or fled.

name: Ember Setback
description: Drive the butt of the stock into the foe's body when the bow is empty and the foe is close.

name: Draught Stirrup
description: Turn aside a thrust with the flat of the prod limb held across the body.

name: Brawn Twang
description: Slip a half step to the side to clear the foe's reach before striking or loosing.

name: Poise Sear
description: Turn the bow in the hands and take the prod like a club for a swing at close quarters.

name: Cruel Span
description: Press the bow close to the foe and loose a bolt at a range too short to miss.

name: Savage Cranking
description: Sweep the stock across the foe's guard and rebound it back into a firing hold.

name: Honedstock
description: Knock the foe's guard aside with the stock and loose a bolt through the opening.

name: Candor Boltrail
description: Pick a narrow bodkin head by feel for a target that wears armour.

name: Brawn Cranequin
description: Seat the narrow bodkin point square on the shaft so no force is lost on impact.

name: Patient Bowprod
description: Find the seam between plates by eye and fix the aim on it.

name: Twangscorer
description: Loose a bodkin quarrel on a flat line to strike armour square on.

name: Brawnstock
description: Balance the quarrel on a finger to find the point where its weight sits forward.

name: Genial Latch
description: Hone the bodkin edge with a few strokes of a small stone before the fight.

name: Raw Trigger
description: Loose a quarrel carrying a pulse of qi into the seam between armour plates to open it.

name: Harsh Cranking
description: Drive a narrow bolt through many layers of quilted cloth and mail with qi along the shaft.

name: Draught Tripbar
description: Dash low from one hedge or bush to the next with the bow held tight to the body.

name: Attentive Stock
description: Stop for one breath behind cover to fix on a mark before moving again.

name: Stockscorer
description: Loose one bolt and step back at once so the foe cannot close.

name: Candor Stirrup
description: Glance behind between shots to know where the path of retreat lies.

name: Searcordial
description: Span and seat a bolt while running by weaving the draw into the rhythm of the stride.

name: Sleet Releaseclack
description: Halt and loose two quick bolts with qi in the hands and then move away.

name: Poise Windlass
description: Tie a thin cord to the bolt shaft with a knot that will not slip in flight.

name: Recall Boltrail
description: Feed out the cord by hand to check that it runs free of the stock.

name: Candorlatch
description: Drop the aim to the lower leg of a walking target and read its stride.

name: Raw Releaseclack
description: Loose a blunted bolt at the shin of a moving mark.

name: Gaplatch
description: Lower the sighting eye along the rail so the calf sits in line with the head.

name: Prowling Twang
description: Step back out of reach of a foe who has begun to stumble.

name: Twang Screen
description: Loose a cord-trailing bolt whose cord wraps the leg and binds the stride.

name: Levering Span
description: Strike the knee of a running foe with a blunt bolt so the stride breaks and the foe falls.

name: Binding Setback
description: Haul on the trailing cord with qi in the arms to drag a snared foe off balance.

name: Dawn Latch
description: Squat low under the bow and use the legs rather than the back to start the draw.

name: Trigger Cordial
description: Set both feet on a wide stirrup bar to hold the bow firm against the ground.

name: Dawn Windlass
description: Haul the span lever in a steady count with qi in the shoulders to avoid sudden strain.

name: Humlatch
description: Listen for the creak of the prod under draw and stop if it sounds wrong.

name: Sound Cranequin
description: Seat a long heavy bolt on the rail and press the fletching flat against the groove.

name: Dawn Tripbar
description: Hold the spanned heavy bow level through a slow breath cycle before the release.

name: Shard Stirrup
description: Loose a heavy bolt at a slow measured release so the whole stored force drives into the mark.

name: Brutal Releaseclack
description: Drive a stout bolt into a foe's shield or armour so the impact rocks the body and breaks balance.
